purpose: Physical custody for source-authored quest hand-ins; no custom use effects.
decision: Lane qc: Twenty Miles and Lizard Sanctuary hand-in items

description.value: Through the brown glistening shell you see movement.
It is worn and scratched, with a faint engraving 'To Roswitha, Forever'.
A heavy coin of ancient gold, tarnished and with an ominous feel to it.
A sea shell formed like a listening ear, shimmering enticingly.
It shows the cardinal directions and also many other symbols that you cannot decipher.
